manufactureInstallation.window: Extruded aluminum outer frame, twin tracks, two sliding sash leaves, recessed float glass, EPDM glazing gaskets, meeting-stile crescent lock, pull recess, rollers, glazing beads, weather brush seals and sill weep cavities.
manufactureInstallation.screen: Four aluminum rails, EPDM spline, crossed polyester screen geometry and finger pull. Screen is exterior and removable.
manufactureInstallation.flashing: Thin formed aluminum sill pan with positive outward fall, rear upstand, front drop, hemmed drip edge, end dams, mechanical fasteners and EPDM isolation washers.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Sliding leaves overlap at meeting stiles; glass is recessed behind gasket geometry; screen remains outside sash plane; flashing sits below frame and projects outward.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Exterior is +Z; drainage is downward/outward. Japanese midsummer sun/sky is intended for future Unity lookdev, not baked.
manufactureInstallation.aging: No arbitrary dirt or rust. Future weathering should follow sill corners, weep paths, track water paths, gasket compression and lower exterior aluminum.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Frame profiles, rails, gaskets, lock, rollers, brush seals, drainage cavities, screen strands and flashing are geometry. Deterministic 128px base/MR/normal textures carry fine extrusion, rubber and zinc microdetail.

assumptions: Nominal 1800x1800 two-track sash; not asserted as a specific historical Japanese SKU.
Nominal 870x1760 insect screen. Geometry pitch is deliberately coarser than real insect mesh and is a lookdev proxy.
Nominal 1800 sill flashing with 6 mm fall over 125 mm projection.
Glass transmission/refraction remains unverified outside Unity.
sourceEquivalence: Repository source is the executed source with only one leading newline removed; Git blob SHA verified after that normalization.
nextProductionTarget: Window-wall perimeter sealant/backer rod and causal sill weathering; integrate with AC/service-corner only after owner review. If Unity pixels appear, score/fix them first.
